nom: NEOGEN Carrot Deep Clear Cleansing Oil Pad

avis.texte: These wonderful makeup removing pads work wonders on my skin! They remove makeup easily and super fast, I love using them as the first step in my skincare routine and follow with my second cleaner. Love! Gifted by neogen

this is such an innovative product, it makes oil cleansing so easy, the oil is lightweight and not too thick that it clogs my pore like some oil cleansers have in the past. i'm a fan especially for hot summer days where i'm wearing a ton of sunscreen complimentary from neogen
These pads are super great for removing makeup. I love the different textures they have (one small bumps and the other smooth).

I love these pads. They're very good for removing makeup. I also love how they have 2 different textures on each side. They also smell good and are good for your skin. My skin feels soft, nourished, and hydrated after using these. Gifted by neogen

I received these cleansing pads complimentary from neogen in exchange for my honest review. I thought they smelled pleasant, and I was very impressed with how quickly and easily they removed my makeup! Much faster than my usual. However, while the oil is lightweight, it felt like a lot of oil on my skin (combination leaning oily), and it was a little tricky to feel like I fully removed the oil with my normal cleanser afterwards. I think this would be great for someone who has dry or normal skin. If you do tend to have oilier skin (like me), I found it helpful to dab off some of the product from the pad before cleansing. It still worked effectively for me with less excess oil afterwards. Again, it is *very* effective and quick for removing sunscreen, makeup, etc., and I do like that the pads have different textures on each side. Just a bit too much product on the pads for someone with my skin type.

I received a sample of this product from complimentary from Neogen in exchange for my honest review and my honest review is that I feel like this is a very innovative product that fills a very important niche. I definitely double cleanse every day but sometimes I just don't want to bother with using an oil cleanser first/rinse/then a foaming cleanser. What this product allows you to do is remove your makeup/sunscreen/primer first without rinsing and then following it up with a foaming cleanser. I think it's an excellent product and I've been very happy and grateful to be able to test it out.

These are sooo convenient! I love cleansing oil, as I wear makeup and spf every day so it's a must. These are perfect for when I don't feel like double cleansing, it somehow feels like I'm not. I just swipe the pad across my face and work it in, then rinse and it is so nice! complimentary from neogen

avis.titre: Perfect cleansing pads for makeup removal
avis.texte: Complimentary from neogen. This set of deep oil cleansing pads from neogen is a fantastic first step in my skincare routine. The pans are soft, easy to separate, and glide easily across my skin. I found that the pads removed stubborn makeup and sunscreen without irritation. It is an oil cleanser, and it does need to be washed off afterward with a follow up cleanser to remove any extra oil. It washed quickly when I followed it with another cleanser, but it was the perfect initial powerhouse product to tackle my makeup for the day. I definitely recommend them!

I've been using the Neogen Carrot Deep Clear Cleansing Oil Pads for a little bit now and they've honestly made my routine so much easier. Each pad is already soaked in a cleansing oil, so it removes makeup and works as an oil cleanse all in one step — no extra products needed. The oil itself feels really nice — lightweight but still rich enough to break down makeup and SPF without feeling heavy or greasy on my skin. It leaves my face feeling clean and soft, not stripped. I especially love these for travel or days when I'm feeling lazy (or rushed in the morning). Just grab a pad and you're done — super convenient and no mess. I received this product complimentary from Neogen, and I've genuinely been reaching for it because it's just so easy to use.

This oil is very lightweight and not too heavy. I have sensitive skin and lots of cleansing oils clog my pores and cause me to break out but this product hasn't caused my skin any reaction. I'm always traveling so this is perfect for on the go and u don't have to worry about bringing a liquid oil cleanser. It's also perfect for lazy days when removing makeup. gifted by Neogen

complimentary from neogen... I really like these double-sided pads. I like using them because they efficiently remove my makeup without being too stripping. I like using the textured side to really get into my creases to really get the makeup out.

Complimentary from Neogen, for my honest thoughts. This product is actually good, and I prefer it instead of the cleansing balms. As I start to massage my face, then I can feel the oil release more. It's a lightweight oil. It does a great job, and I do double cleanse. I don't like to use the pad around the eyes. I think it releases a little too much oil, so that's why. I'll just use finger tips, and not the pad. It's good though, I have been enjoying it. My feels clean, but also moisturized, I have dry skin.

I received this gifted by neogen. The cleansing oil pads are so convenient to use. I like that you just have to take one pad and that's good enough for your entire face. These pads feel very soothing, but do a good job of removing my makeup in one swipe, especially my more stubborn eye makeup. I really enjoy using this product.

I have skin that gets congested so easily . These work so well to remove my makeup . I also really enjoy the pad form as it's really convenient. I also am glad to say it doesn't cause my sensitive skin to break out . gifted by neogen

I use this cleansing pad to remove my heavy make up at the end of the day. I can toss this in my gym bag and bring it with me in my car. I use the other side to exfoliate. This pad is good to get ride of eye, lip and face make up. I find this product easy to use and multifunctional. gifted by Neogen

Let me just start off by saying that I'm lazy and I look for convenience everywhere. I also hate taking off my sunscreen at the end of the day. These wipes are a life saver! I just grab a wipe and I can cleanse off all the sunscreen off my face without needing a separate oil cleanser. I'll then just either wash my face or just wipe off with a micellar wipe if I'm extra lazy. Overall I love these, so easy and so convenient, and also mess free! I received these complimentary from neogen in exchange for my honest review.

These cleansing pads are so convenient for busy evenings and travel. They're mess-free and much easier than using a liquid cleansing oil. I love the dual-sided design—the textured side provides gentle exfoliation, while the smooth side finishes the cleanse. My skin feels comfortable, nourished, and refreshed after every use without feeling tight or dry. complimentary from neogen

I was impressed with how easily this cleansing pad removed my waterproof mascara, long-wear makeup, and sunscreen. I only needed a few gentle swipes, and it left my skin feeling clean without any greasy residue. The textured side helped lift stubborn makeup, while the smooth side left my skin feeling soft and refreshed. complimentary from neogen

I really loved how much this took my makeup of my face as well as lenses it! It took everything off! My skin feels very refreshed and soft after use. I have combo sensitive skin and this worked really well with it. Definitely will keep this in my skin care routine gifted by Neogen

I absolutely love these toner pads. They are so hydrating and cleans everything off my face. They literally melt everything off my face. The package is very easy to open and use, definitely recommend them. gifted by neogen

avis.titre: Easiest way to remove all my makeup
avis.texte: I love these cleansing pads complimentary from neogen. They easily remove my waterproof makeup and sunscreen without harsh scrubbing on my skin. They are perfect for those nights when I just don't feel like doing multiple steps because they are just so easy! I also love that I can throw them in my travel bag and they won't leak. Super convenient and they do a perfect job.

This has been a game changer for removing my makeup, I typically double cleanse but some days I'm feeling lazy and I'll use these as my first step. They are also super convenient for travel as opposed to traveling with an oil. They also leave my face feeling nice and not dryer out. Gifted by Neogen.

(gifted by neogen) i don't think there is an easier and more effective way to remove makeup! i love that the pads are concentrated with cleansing oil so that my makeup comes off seamlessly. it removes my eyeliner/mascara very well and i don't feel remaining residue once i'm done.

This dual sided pad worked like a charm to get my makeup off after a long day. I like that it gently cleanses and exfoliates. The textured side was the right texture to gently remove oils. I also used the softer side to gently swipe around my face. This was complimentary from neogen.

Great cleansing pad that helps take off my makeup and sunscreen really quickly while smelling like carrots great if you are in the lazy side and like to have less steps than usual. Would get again for sure. Gifted by neogen

complimentary from neogen Unfortunately I wouldn't recommend this product for anyone with oily skin or sensitivities, it's a bit of a sensory nightmare and its overly oily and broke my skin out. Removed makeup fairly well but the oil is overwhelming. It gets all over the packing. Might be good for VERY dry skin types.
I love this as it really does a good job taking my sunscreen and makeup off. I play sports so it's handy to toss into my gym bag and cleanse my face easily. complimentary from neogen

I've been using the Neogen Carrot Deep Clear Remover Pads for a few weeks now, and they've quickly become one of my favorite first-step cleansing products. The pads are generously sized and soaked with enough product to break down a full face of makeup without feeling overly oily or messy. I usually only need one pad to remove my foundation, sunscreen, and most of my eye makeup. Complimentary from Neogen.

This was a different product that I have used from other products to use to remove your base make up and I think it does a pretty good job whenever I pull out the pad it's just different to me because I'm not expecting oil. I'm expecting it to clean my face. It doesn't have any strong smell. The pads are pretty big. They have a rough side and a side and I don't know I think that it's a good makeup remover, but then you have to wash it off or use another cleanser to wash the oil off and it does leave a light residue of oil if you choose to use just the water. I think it's good to use this on the go, but then you have to use another cleanser which then defeats the purpose of it being convenient. I think that it's a good product to use if you have dry skin and if you want to make sure that you remove all your makeup before cleansing your skin complimentary from neogen

These have been working really well so far in removing my makeup and I love how easy they are to use! I tend to use this as an extra step in my cleansing routine but I feel like on its own, these pads have been doing a pretty good job. I haven't been experiencing any breakouts with my sensitive skin. I love the fact that both sides of a pad serve different purposes where I can use one side for simply cleaning my face and the other for exfoliating because it allows me to get the most use out of the product. This has been perfect for busy days. gifted by neogen

Received complimentary from: Neogen: Carrot Deep Clear Cleansing Oil Pad. I love these pads, they remove all the makeup super well and do not irritate, remove all the makeup, it is very easy to remove water. Become my favorite makeup remover.

These have become one of my favorite skincare shortcuts. I love how easy they are to use, especially on busy nights when I just want to get my makeup off and get to bed. The cleansing oil does a great job breaking down sunscreen and makeup, and my skin feels soft afterward instead of oily. I was worried they might irritate my skin, but they've actually been really gentle. My face feels clean, hydrated, and much less congested since adding them to my routine. gifted by neogen

These cleansing pads are perfect for anyone with dry skin like myself. They remove sunscreen and makeup so easily without drying out my skin, and are perfect for taking with me on the go. I love how easy and mess-free they make cleaning my face. Gifted by Neogen

avis.titre: Benefits of an oil cleanser, convenience of a wipe
avis.texte: I received this complimentary from Neogen in exchange for my honest review. I've been double cleansing my face with cleansing oil or balm for years. I love the benefits of removing makeup with an oil based wash and these wipes make it so much easier to double cleanse especially when traveling. There's a good amount and if you're not wearing a lot or any makeup they can be stretched even further by cutting them in half.

The NEOGEN Carrot Deep Clear Cleansing Oil Pads have made my nighttime routine so much easier. I was curious about the oil pad concept, and it exceeded my expectations. The pads are soft, durable, and packed with enough product to cleanse thoroughly. They melt away sunscreen, foundation, and lip products in just a few swipes. I don't have to tug at my skin to remove stubborn makeup anymore. The cleansing oil feels silky and comfortable on the face. It breaks down impurities without clogging my pores. After rinsing, my skin feels hydrated instead of tight. I enjoy using the textured side to gently massage and lift away buildup. The smooth side is perfect for wiping away any remaining residue. These pads are also great for days when I wear minimal makeup because they cleanse quickly. The packaging is sturdy and keeps the product fresh. I have sensitive skin, and I haven't noticed any irritation after repeated use. The formula leaves my face looking clean, soft, and healthy. It works beautifully as the first step before my regular facial cleanser. I appreciate that it doesn't leave an oily film behind. The carrot-infused formula gives the product a fresh and comforting feel. Cleanup is simple, and there is no mess compared to pouring cleansing oil into my hands. I find myself reaching for these pads every evening because they are so convenient. Overall, this is a thoughtful, effective, and high-quality cleansing product that I would happily purchase again. complimentary from Neo

These cleansing oil pads are lightweight. It removes make up effortlessly. These oil pads are perfect for travel and convenient. They feel gentle on my skin. i would recommend this product. I received this product complimentary from Neogen.

I have been using the NEOGEN Carrot Deep Clear Cleansing Oil Pads for a few weeks, and they have become one of my favorite skincare products. The pads are generously soaked with cleansing oil and feel very soft on the skin. They easily remove makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup without needing to scrub. I especially like how they melt away waterproof mascara with very little effort. The carrot seed oil formula feels nourishing instead of greasy. My skin never feels stripped or dry after using them. Each pad has enough product to cleanse my entire face thoroughly. The textured side helps lift away impurities, while the smooth side leaves my skin feeling refreshed. I noticed that my pores look cleaner after regular use. They are also very convenient for busy nights when I do not want a complicated routine. The packaging is sturdy and keeps the pads from drying out. The scent is light and pleasant without being overpowering. I have sensitive skin, and these pads did not cause any irritation or redness. They rinse off easily and do not leave behind a heavy residue. My face feels soft and hydrated after every use. I also appreciate that they work well as the first step in a double-cleansing routine. The quality of the ingredients makes the product feel luxurious. A little goes a long way because each pad is packed with cleansing oil. I would definitely repurchase these cleansing pads. They are a simple and effective addition to my nightly skincare routine. complimentary from Neog

Okay I'm loving these cleansing pads gifted by Neogen. It removes my makeup so well and cleans my face without over drying it. It keeps my skin glowy and clean. Love love using this after a night out.

gifted by neogen. I love the idea of these pads. Usually I use a cleansing oil or balm, but these are great for lazy days when I just can't bother with a long routine. The pads were really well soaked, and I just held one against my eye and it melted off my makeup (sunscreen and foundation too). Absolutely loved the experience!

Gifted by neogen. I absolutely love these cleansing wipes, they really take off all of the dirt on my face and helps maintain a clean face! It does not irritate my face and helps clear out my pores. I highly recommend!

These cleansing oil pads made taking off makeup so quick and effortless. They melt away sunscreen and even stubborn eye makeup without tugging, and the dual-sided pad leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed instead of greasy. I love that they're convenient for travel or lazy nights when I don't want to deal with a bottle of cleansing oil. They rinse off easily and don't leave behind a heavy residue. Definitely a great option for anyone looking for an easy first cleanse. Gifted by Neogen.

This was complimentary from neogen. I've never used a cleansing oil pad before so this was really interesting and new to me. I like how it took off all my makeup and prepped my skin for double cleansing!

gifted by neogen This product easily removes my makeup love how it keeps my face nice and clean. These pads are perfect for on the go. I love them very much. I will definitely be repurchasing again…….
